locked_reproduce_2026_07_16.notes: Mean of 3 independent full-trajectory runs, all on the same wrapper config+dataset, after fixing 3 undefined-behavior bugs (heap-buffer-underflow in formator.cpp, heap-use-after-free in gnss_imu_initializer.cpp, uninitialized-memory read in third_party/rtklib/src/rinex.c -- see research/UPSTREAM_FIDELITY.md). Pre-fix, 4 runs of the identical config+dataset gave 6.9/7.5/14.1/16.8 m (chaotic, crash-prone ~3/5 of the time). Post-fix, 3 runs cluster within 0.5 m -- reproducibility is fixed. The residual ~8m vs paper's 3.4m is a real, separate accuracy gap, not non-determinism.

retired_prior_locked_reproduce_2026_07_1.notes: One data point from the pre-fix non-reproducible era (6.9/7.5/14.1/16.8 m spread across identical runs); superseded by locked_reproduce_2026_07_16 above, kept for archaeology.

notes: Reproducibility bug fixed (see status field).
